brief.en: The item concerns a supplementary election to the Constitutional Law Committee and was processed from 11 June to 8 July 2026. The data contains no substance of the proposal, so specific rule, benefit, eligibility or change decisions cannot be described. The item is marked processed, but that alone does not show whether the election was carried out. The subject relates to committee work, not directly to any ready-made theme.
